evidence.name: tinfl_clear_tree

evidence.numbered_text:
142|#define TINFL_HUFF_DECODE(state_index, sym, pLookUp, pTree)                                                                         \
143|    do                                                                                                                              \
144|    {                                                                                                                               \
145|        int temp;                                                                                                                   \
146|        mz_uint code_len, c;                                                                                                        \
147|        if (num_bits < 15)                                                                                                          \
148|        {                                                                                                                           \
149|            if ((pIn_buf_end - pIn_buf_cur) < 2)                                                                                    \
150|            {                                                                                                                       \
151|                TINFL_HUFF_BITBUF_FILL(state_index, pLookUp, pTree);                                                                \
152|            }                                                                                                                       \
153|            else                                                                                                                    \
154|            {                                                                                                                       \
155|                bit_buf |= (((tinfl_bit_buf_t)pIn_buf_cur[0]) << num_bits) | (((tinfl_bit_buf_t)pIn_buf_cur[1]) << (num_bits + 8)); \
156|                pIn_buf_cur += 2;                                                                                                   \
157|                num_bits += 16;                                                                                                     \
158|            }                                                                                                                       \
159|        }                                                                                                                           \
160|        if ((temp = pLookUp[bit_buf & (TINFL_FAST_LOOKUP_SIZE - 1)]) >= 0)                                                          \
161|            code_len = temp >> 9, temp &= 511;                                                                                      \
162|        else                                                                                                                        \
163|        {                                                                                                                           \
164|            code_len = TINFL_FAST_LOOKUP_BITS;                                                                                      \
165|            do                                                                                                                      \
166|            {                                                                                                                       \
167|                temp = pTree[~temp + ((bit_buf >> code_len++) & 1)];                                                                \
168|            } while (temp < 0);                                                                                                     \
169|        }                                                                                                                           \
170|        sym = temp;                                                                                                                 \
171|        bit_buf >>= code_len;                                                                                                       \
172|        num_bits -= code_len;                                                                                                       \
173|    }                                                                                                                               \
174|    MZ_MACRO_END
175|
